brief:
Middle East Eye reported that a Palestinian petition demanding British acknowledgement and redress for colonial abuses remains unanswered more than a century after the Balfour Declaration. The petition marks the 109th anniversary of Britain's 1917 pledge supporting a Jewish homeland in Palestine, a decision Palestinians say enabled decades of displacement and suffering under colonial rule.

The unresponded petition highlights ongoing Palestinian demands that Britain take responsibility for its role in establishing the conditions that led to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Advocates argue that Britain's current criticism of abuses in Palestine contradicts its refusal to address its own historical accountability for colonial policies in the territory.

title: Britain faces renewed calls to reckon with colonial abuses in Palestine
